title: 12 Best Momo Spots in Kathmandu
description: The best momos in Kathmandu — curated from Reddit and local food blogs. Buff momos, jhol momos, open momos, fried chilli momos and more.

places.name: Newa MoMo Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: Newa MoMo in Thamel — it's quite out of the way down a small alley, but there are signs, so get exploring! I recommend the buff and the potato cheese momos.
redditQuotes.source: — Emily Luxton · Best Momos in Kathmandu

redditQuotes.text: Newa MoMo Restaurant also run momo cooking classes which would be a fantastic way to learn more about the favorite Himalayan snack.
redditQuotes.source: — r/NepaliFood · Best Momos in Kathmandu Thread

places.verdict: The single most recommended momo spot by travelers and Nepali locals alike — hidden down a Thamel alley, offering cooking classes too.

comparison.best for: Authentic Newari-style momos in a casual Thamel setting
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 907 reviews · Cash-only · Good for groups and solo
comparison.limitations: Cash only · Can get crowded during peak hours · Down a hard-to-find alley
comparison.what to order: Buff (buffalo) momos are the star — rich, juicy, and perfectly spiced. The potato cheese momos are excellent for vegetarians. Also offers chocolate momos and momo cooking classes.

places.whatToOrder: Buff (buffalo) momos are the star — rich, juicy, and perfectly spiced. The potato cheese momos are excellent for vegetarians. Also offers chocolate momos and momo cooking classes.

places.name: Yangling Tibetan Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: These were possibly the best momos I had — definitely the biggest. Go for the fried chilly momos which come slathered in a sticky, not-too-spicy sauce and are total heaven.
redditQuotes.source: — Common Wanderer · Best Momos in Kathmandu

places.verdict: The biggest, juiciest momos in Kathmandu — their fried chilli momos slathered in sticky sauce are what momo dreams are made of.

comparison.best for: Fried chilli momos and Tibetan-style dumplings
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 1,320 reviews · Biggest momos in town · Tibetan authenticity
comparison.limitations: Restaurant has moved — no longer where Google Maps says, ask around
comparison.price / value: NPR 150–250 · Good value for portion size
comparison.what to order: The fried chilli momos are the must-order — slathered in a sticky, not-too-spicy sauce. Pork chilli momos (NPR 250) are the signature. Steamed buff momos are also excellent.

places.whatToOrder: The fried chilli momos are the must-order — slathered in a sticky, not-too-spicy sauce. Pork chilli momos (NPR 250) are the signature. Steamed buff momos are also excellent.

places.name: Kathmandu Grill Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: Kathmandu Grill takes pride in serving up both veg and chicken momos that are bursting with flavor. Known for its hygiene and impeccable service.
redditQuotes.source: — Himalayan Glacier · Best Momo Places in Kathmandu

places.verdict: The highest-rated restaurant in Thamel — an elevated momo experience with impeccable hygiene and stylish ambiance.

comparison.best for: A refined momo experience in a comfortable Thamel setting
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 2,199 reviews · Hygiene-focused · Both veg and chicken momos
comparison.limitations: Higher prices than street stalls · More touristy atmosphere
comparison.price / value: NPR 250–600 · Premium for Kathmandu, still cheap by Western standards
comparison.what to order: Both veg and chicken momos are excellent. Try the momo platter to sample different styles — steamed, fried, and kothey (pan-fried on one side).

places.whatToOrder: Both veg and chicken momos are excellent. Try the momo platter to sample different styles — steamed, fried, and kothey (pan-fried on one side).

places.name: Ghangri Cafe

redditQuotes.text: Ghangri Cafe in Pulchowk is quite good. Especially because of their achar.

places.verdict: Famous for their signature open momos — partially folded to expose fillings in four compartments, served with three kinds of chutneys including peanut and mint.

comparison.best for: Open momos with creative chutney pairings
comparison.strengths: 4★ from 2,254 reviews · Unique open-momo format · Excellent achar (chutney)
comparison.limitations: In Lalitpur — a taxi ride from central Kathmandu/Thamel
comparison.price / value: NPR 200–400 · Worth the trip to Jhamsikhel
comparison.what to order: Open momos with all three chutneys — drip the peanut and mint chutneys over the exposed fillings for a flavour explosion. The achar here is consistently praised as the best in the valley.

places.whatToOrder: Open momos with all three chutneys — drip the peanut and mint chutneys over the exposed fillings for a flavour explosion. The achar here is consistently praised as the best in the valley.

places.name: Darjeeling Momo Sukedhara

redditQuotes.text: Few months back I ate from Darjeeling Momo Sukedhara, it was so yummm.
redditQuotes.source: — r/NepaliFood · Favorite Momo Places in Kathmandu

places.verdict: A local favourite for outstandingly juicy momos — the kind of place Nepalis send each other to. Worth the trip to Sukedhara.

comparison.best for: Juicy, flavourful momos at local prices away from the tourist circuit
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 193 reviews · Extremely juicy filling · Local atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Outside tourist areas in Sukedhara · Basic seating
comparison.what to order: Their momos are praised for being extraordinarily juicy. Try the buff or chicken steamed momos — the filling bursts with flavour.

places.whatToOrder: Their momos are praised for being extraordinarily juicy. Try the buff or chicken steamed momos — the filling bursts with flavour.

places.name: Ram Dai ko Momo Pasal

redditQuotes.text: Ram Dai ko Momo Pasal is a must-visit for any momo enthusiast in Kathmandu. This family-run establishment has been serving up mouthwatering buff momos for decades.
redditQuotes.source: — Himalayan Glacier · 10 Best Momo Places in Kathmandu

places.verdict: A decades-old family-run buff momo legend beside the iconic Kasthamandap temple — the most authentic street-momo experience in Kathmandu.

comparison.best for: Authentic street-stall buff momos near Durbar Square
comparison.strengths: Decades of history · Rich, tender buff filling · True local institution
comparison.limitations: Tiny corner shop · Gets crowded · Cash only · Basic seating
comparison.price / value: NPR 80–150 · Among the cheapest momos in the valley
comparison.what to order: Buff (buffalo) momos — it's what they're famous for. Rich, tender, and deeply flavourful. Get the spicy tomato achar on the side.

places.whatToOrder: Buff (buffalo) momos — it's what they're famous for. Rich, tender, and deeply flavourful. Get the spicy tomato achar on the side.

places.name: Aambo Momo

redditQuotes.text: Aambo Momo is a mega popular spot for momo in Kathmandu, and there are few locales around the city.
redditQuotes.source: — The Frugal Foodies · Thamel Momo Crawl

places.verdict: A mega-popular Kathmandu momo chain with multiple locations — convenient, consistent, and a solid starting point for first-timers.

comparison.best for: A reliable, easy-to-find momo spot in Thamel
comparison.limitations: Chain feel — less character than hole-in-the-wall spots
comparison.what to order: Their classic steamed buff momos and jhol momos are both solid. Good variety of fillings available.

places.whatToOrder: Their classic steamed buff momos and jhol momos are both solid. Good variety of fillings available.

places.name: Thamel Momo Hut

redditQuotes.text: Delicious Momos. A great selection of vegetarian and meat, steamed and pan fried, savoury and sweet (try the chocolate momos). Order a couple of different types.

places.verdict: A great selection of vegetarian and meat momos — steamed, pan-fried, and even sweet chocolate momos. A fun Thamel experience.

comparison.best for: Trying multiple momo styles in one sitting — steamed, fried, sweet
comparison.strengths: 4.1★ from 885 reviews · Huge variety including chocolate momos · Central location
comparison.what to order: Order a couple of different plates — the pan-fried momos and the chocolate momos are unique. The steamed buff and chicken are reliable staples.

places.whatToOrder: Order a couple of different plates — the pan-fried momos and the chocolate momos are unique. The steamed buff and chicken are reliable staples.

places.name: Bagmati Sweets

redditQuotes.text: Bagmati Sweets in Tripureshwar is a hidden gem for momo lovers. Their paneer momos are simply divine! A word of caution: the best time to enjoy these is between 11:30 AM and 2 PM.
redditQuotes.source: — Himalayan Glacier · Best Momo Places in Kathmandu

places.verdict: A hidden gem for vegetarian momo lovers — their paneer momos with homemade tomato achar are divine. Timing is everything: go between 11:30 AM and 2 PM.

comparison.best for: Vegetarian paneer momos with outstanding homemade achar
comparison.strengths: 4★ from 624 reviews · Legendary paneer filling · Homemade achar like mom's recipe
comparison.limitations: Best momos only available 11:30 AM–2 PM · Outside tourist areas
comparison.what to order: Paneer momos — generously stuffed with flavourful paneer filling. The homemade tomato achar is the real star — spicy and tangy, it elevates the momos to a whole new level.

places.whatToOrder: Paneer momos — generously stuffed with flavourful paneer filling. The homemade tomato achar is the real star — spicy and tangy, it elevates the momos to a whole new level.

places.name: GG Machaan Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: GG Machaan serves jhol momos to perfection. The flavorful broth, infused with coriander and a subtle hint of peanuts, is the ideal complement to the perfectly cooked dumplings.

places.verdict: The place for jhol momos — steamed dumplings swimming in a warming broth infused with coriander, peanuts, and timur pepper. Perfect for cold evenings.

comparison.best for: Jhol (soup) momos — the ultimate cold-weather comfort food
comparison.strengths: 4★ from 384 reviews · Outstanding jhol broth · Multiple filling options
comparison.limitations: In Lalitpur — requires a taxi from Thamel
comparison.what to order: Jhol momos in buff or chicken — the broth is the star, infused with coriander and a subtle hint of peanuts. Ask for extra spicy if you can handle it.

places.whatToOrder: Jhol momos in buff or chicken — the broth is the star, infused with coriander and a subtle hint of peanuts. Ask for extra spicy if you can handle it.

places.name: Sandar Momo

redditQuotes.text: Shandar Momo — order your momos to go and enjoy the classic Nepali street food tradition of eating them on the spot. Put lots of sauce in the container.

places.verdict: The quintessential Kathmandu street momo experience — grab a takeaway container, load up on sauce, and eat overlooking Basantapur's busy Durbar Square.

comparison.best for: Cheapest momos in the guide — classic street food at Durbar Square
comparison.strengths: Rock-bottom prices · Authentic street-food atmosphere · Central location
comparison.limitations: No-frills eatery · Takeaway focused · Basic hygiene
comparison.what to order: Get the steamed momos to go — load up the container with their spicy sauce and enjoy the classic Nepali street food tradition in Basantapur's busy atmosphere.

places.whatToOrder: Get the steamed momos to go — load up the container with their spicy sauce and enjoy the classic Nepali street food tradition in Basantapur's busy atmosphere.

places.name: Everest MoMo Center

redditQuotes.text: Everest Momo at Naxal — try Paropakar branch for the authentic taste.
redditQuotes.source: — Facebook · Top Local Momo Spots in Kathmandu

places.verdict: A Naxal institution known for consistent, classic momos — a solid neighbourhood favourite that locals swear by.

comparison.best for: Classic no-frills momos in the Naxal neighbourhood
comparison.strengths: 3.9★ from 804 reviews · Consistent quality · Long-established local spot
comparison.what to order: Their standard buff and chicken steamed momos are reliable. A solid spot for a quick momo fix if you're in the Naxal area.

places.whatToOrder: Their standard buff and chicken steamed momos are reliable. A solid spot for a quick momo fix if you're in the Naxal area.
